project_name: Tart & Tine: A Little Braver Together
storyboard_note: Static concept images with four panels per chapter; not animated video and not a verified first/last frame. Source sheets remain the canonical character identity anchors.
pending_stages: Correct ark:GetApiKey permission or AK/SK/endpoint pairing
Render six 10-second chapters with native audio
Inspect selected takes, assemble and verify movie

shot_ledger.action: @Tart and @Tine sit together in @garden, ears perked. @Tart glances shyly at @Tine; @Tine answers with a bright tail wag.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm wide at puppy eye height; slow push toward both puppies
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Soft breeze, distant birds; original playful piano motif begins.
shot_ledger.end_state: Tart looks toward the ball; Tine lifts one forepaw.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine lowers a forepaw onto @ball and gently nudges it along the gravel path; @Tart tilts the head in delight.
shot_ledger.camera: 50mm medium two-shot; paws and faces in one coherent composition
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Soft rubber tap and gravel tick; pizzicato joins piano.
shot_ledger.end_state: The ball starts rolling east, screen-left to screen-right.

shot_ledger.action: @Tart and @Tine trot after @ball through @garden toward the near bridge ramp. @Tine leads by half a body length.
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Light paw patter; vest cloth flutter; upbeat motif.
shot_ledger.end_state: Ball reaches the near bridge ramp; both dogs are approaching behind it.

shot_ledger.action: @ball rolls slowly over the low wooden bridge in @garden and settles in grass beside the far-side daisies.
shot_ledger.camera: 50mm ground-level follow; show near ramp, bridge crown, far ramp and destination
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Gentle wood roll, then soft grass rustle.
shot_ledger.end_state: Ball is stationary beside the far ramp, on the right.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine crosses the bridge confidently and stops beside @ball. @Tart reaches the near ramp and slows.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm wide side view; both ramps visible; no axis crossing
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Paw taps on wood; piano skips upward.
shot_ledger.end_state: Tine stands at the far ramp; Tart remains at the near ramp.

shot_ledger.action: @Tart places one paw on the first bridge plank in @garden, hears a tiny creak, and withdraws the paw. Ears droop; eyes look across toward @Tine.
shot_ledger.camera: 65mm close-up from near-side three-quarter view; bridge stays low and safe
shot_ledger.audio_direction: A small wood creak; a soft canine breath; score thins to two piano notes.
shot_ledger.end_state: Tart has all four paws on near-side gravel, hesitant but safe.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine looks from stationary @ball to @Tart across the bridge in @garden. Playful expression softens into concern.
shot_ledger.camera: 65mm medium close-up; rack focus from ball to Tart across bridge
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Bird ambience; piano holds a warm chord.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine walks back across the bridge in @garden, right to left, slowing as the puppy reaches @Tart on near-side gravel.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm wide profile maintains the established axis; return direction visibly motivated
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Measured wooden paw taps; gentle pizzicato pulse.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both puppies are together at the near ramp; ball remains far-side.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine gently touches noses with @Tart and waits. @Tart raises the ears, takes a steadying breath and returns the nose touch.
shot_ledger.camera: 85mm close two-shot at nose height; tiny slow push
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Quiet sniff and soft exhale; a tender original piano phrase.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both turn to face the bridge, Tart left and Tine right, shoulder to shoulder.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine places a paw onto the first plank in @garden and waits for @Tart to match the step. Both then advance slowly.
shot_ledger.camera: 50mm low medium two-shot includes both faces and front paws
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Two gentle synchronized taps; encouraging piano phrase.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both puppies have their front paws on the bridge.

shot_ledger.action: At the bridge crown in @garden, @Tart glances at @Tine, then straight ahead. Their ears lift and tails begin to wag as they keep walking.
shot_ledger.camera: 65mm eye-level moving two-shot; subtle background parallax
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Soft wood taps and fur movement; pizzicato grows warmer.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both puppies pass the midpoint, continuing left to right.

shot_ledger.action: @Tart and @Tine step off the far ramp onto grass beside @ball in @garden. @Tart straightens proudly; @Tine gives a little happy bounce.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm wider side view; small upward camera settle at landing
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Grass pawfalls and one happy woof; score opens into a bright chord.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both stand safely on far-side grass; ball sits ahead beside daisies.

shot_ledger.action: @Tine leans toward fragrant daisies in @garden, captivated by the flowers. @Tart looks at @Tine, then at @ball with a knowing smile.
shot_ledger.camera: 50mm medium two-shot; flowers foreground, ball lower center
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Sniff-sniff, leaf rustle; playful flute-like score accent without speech.
shot_ledger.end_state: Tine faces daisies; Tart steps closer to ball.

shot_ledger.action: @Tart nudges @ball gently into @Tine’s field of view. @Tine notices, turns back, and touches a paw to the ball beside Tart’s paw.
shot_ledger.camera: 65mm close view of noses, ball and paws; tilt up to their expressions
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Rubber brushing grass, surprised sniff; familiar piano motif returns.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both puppies are focused together again, ball between their paws.

shot_ledger.action: @Tart and @Tine exchange a delighted look, then gently roll @ball together toward the oak tree in @garden.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm lateral follow resumes left-to-right travel; no fast chase
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Two soft happy woofs; paw patter; lively but tender score.
shot_ledger.end_state: Ball rolls toward tree; both puppies follow side by side.

shot_ledger.action: @ball settles beneath the oak in @garden. @Tart and @Tine arrive together and slow to a stop, breathing lightly after their small adventure.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm wide eye-level; oak frames the pair and bridge remains visible behind
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Soft grass steps; piano cadence begins; garden ambience continues.
shot_ledger.end_state: Ball rests before both puppies; Tart left, Tine right.

shot_ledger.action: @Tart and @Tine sit with shoulders touching in @garden. @Tart rests the head lightly against @Tine; Tine leans back in return. Tails wag softly.
shot_ledger.camera: 65mm medium two-shot, gentle push; cream and brown faces clearly distinct
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Tiny contented sighs, soft vest fabric; original piano resolves.
shot_ledger.end_state: Both rest together peacefully; ball stationary at their paws.

shot_ledger.action: Hold @Tart and @Tine together under the oak in @garden with @ball at their feet. Camera eases back to reveal the little bridge they crossed; warm light catches their orange vests.
shot_ledger.camera: 35mm slow pullback; last composition holds during the final second
shot_ledger.audio_direction: Last piano chord rings and fades naturally; birds and breeze continue.
shot_ledger.end_state: Calm wide final frame with both puppies together; no fade or title changes the runtime.

continuity_review: Single enclosed garden and one consistent late-afternoon light state throughout
Near bridge ramp screen-left; far ramp screen-right; daisies immediately far-side; oak beyond
The blue ball rolls visibly, then stays at far-side daisies during Tine’s return and the shared bridge crossing
Tine returns right-to-left before both puppies cross left-to-right; camera remains on one side of action axis
Tart remains beige; Tine remains brown with pale right rear heart patch; vests consistent
Reference sheet duplicate views must not become extra on-screen dogs
Six times 10 seconds; every chapter has consecutive 3, 3, 4-second shots
No dialogue; original score and scene Foley remain directions pending audio production
verification_scope: Planned timeline, file existence, raster decoding and hashes. No video duration, motion, audio or decode verification is possible before rendering.
